entities.name: Major Teroh
entities.description: An aven leader who vows to avenge the Cabal's victims.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A cephalid ambassador who dreams of seizing control; Empress Llawan says he smiles with poisoned lips.

entities.name: Empress Llawan
entities.description: A cephalid empress who speaks of magic as the tide.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A dementia master of the Cabal whose madness touches Otaria.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A Cabal dementia summoner who dreams of dark rebirth.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A pit fighter who dreams of storms of fire.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur druid who dreams of life renewed.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: The head of the Cabal, who dreams of vile plague.

entities.name: Balthor the Stout
entities.description: A dwarf described by Kamahl as concentrated barbarian.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A death-worshipping order that runs the pits.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact pulsing like a dead sun in the Cabal's vault, radiating darkness across Otaria.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The land hit by an epidemic of insanity.

events.summary: Teroh vows to be the holy wind that avenges the Cabal's victims.
events.quote: I am the holy wind that shall avenge the Cabal's victims.

events.summary: The Mirari pulses in the Cabal's vault and spreads darkness over Otaria.
events.quote: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun—and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

events.summary: Chainer's insanity touches nearly every living thing.
events.quote: Chainer's insanity touched nearly every living thing

events.summary: Chainer gives a dark gift to a darker soul for Laquatus's champion.
events.quote: Chainer's dark gift to a darker soul.
